Package test

Class SlotMachineCoverageTest

java.lang.Object
test.SlotMachineCoverageTest
public class SlotMachineCoverageTest extends Object
Coverage tests for the domain package: error cases and branches of SlotMachine, Wheel and SlotMachineContest that the cycle tests don't reach. The machine is never made visible, so no message dialog is opened.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Oscar Poveda, Elian Ibarra

    Description
    void
    lockedLazyShouldRejectEverySpin()
    Verifies that a locked lazy wheel rejects every spin, even while it is asleep, and that the rejected spins don't wake it up.

    Verifies that a locked lefty wheel rejects a spin without its symbols reacting to it: an ephemeral symbol doesn't shrink.

    Sets up the test fixture.
    void
    shouldAddSymbolFirstWhenPositionIsBelowOne()
    Verifies that a symbol added at a position below 1 is inserted first in the catalog.
    void
    shouldCreateTheContestSolver()
    Verifies that the contest solver can be instantiated.
    void
    shouldDeleteEveryWheel()
    Verifies that every wheel can be deleted, leaving the machine empty, and that deleting from an empty machine fails.
    void
    shouldNotBeJackpotWithoutSymbolsOrWithLessThanTwoWheels()
    Verifies that there's no jackpot without symbols (an error) nor with less than two wheels (not an error).
    void
    shouldNotLockMissingOrAlreadyLockedWheel()
    Verifies that a wheel that doesn't exist or is already locked can't be locked.
    void
    shouldNotPlaceSymbolOnLockedWheel()
    Verifies that a symbol can't be placed on a locked wheel.
    void
    shouldNotSpinAWheelWithoutWheels()
    Verifies that spinning one wheel, with or without steps, fails when the machine has no wheels.
    void
    shouldNotSwapWithoutWheelsOrSameAdjustedWheel()
    Verifies that swap fails without wheels and when both positions end up being the same wheel after being adjusted.
    void
    shouldNotUnlockWithoutWheelsOrMissingWheel()
    Verifies that unlock fails when the machine has no wheels or the wheel doesn't exist.
    void
    shouldReturnNullForWheelOutOfRange()
    Verifies that getWheel returns null for positions that don't exist.
    void
    shouldSpinAllExceptLockedWheel()
    Verifies that spinning all the wheels skips the locked one and still spins the others.
    void
    wheelShouldIgnoreDeletingMissingOrLastSymbol()
    Verifies that a wheel ignores deleting a symbol it doesn't have and deleting its last symbol.
    void
    wheelShouldKeepTheRightSymbolWhenSymbolsAreDeleted()
    Verifies that a wheel keeps showing the right symbol when a symbol before, after or at its current position is deleted.
    void
    wheelsShouldMoveBetweenRows()
    Verifies that wheels move to the next row when a wheel is inserted before the end of a full row, and back to the previous row when a wheel before them is deleted.
    void
    wheelWithoutSymbolsShouldNotFail()
    Verifies that a wheel created without registered symbols can be spun and shows no symbol.
